title: Replace the Leaf app icon with the light sprout design
purpose: Use the supplied light sprout and flowerpot artwork as the Leaf browser and installed app icon while preserving the existing PWA installation configuration.
changes: Replaced the previous crayon plant icon source with the supplied minimal sprout and flowerpot artwork.
Generated matching 512px and 192px PNG variants from the supplied 1024px source.
Preserved the existing favicon, Apple touch icon, and PWA manifest references.
